_comment: Single source of truth for NIL budget tiers. Read by torvik_metrics.py (valuation) and src/lib/nilBudget.js (roster builder). A player's valuation is capped at max_player_share of their tier's team budget, not at a flat dollar amount. competition_factor is the V term in the NIL curve (discounts mid-range production at lower levels). Conferences not listed fall to default_tier.
